retrievalProfile.description: A warm, studio-lit portrait featuring a couple in 1970s attire against a muted teal-grey gradient, utilizing high-contrast typographic pairing of a wide serif and an ornate Spencerian script.
triggerTerms: warm copper and teal color grade
excludeWhen: bright neon or high-saturation pop art is needed
outdoor natural light settings are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a couple standing close together; the man wears a tan suit and fedora with long hair and beard, while the woman wears a white lace top with a large flower in her afro. The lighting is soft but directional, creating a gentle vignette against a solid, desaturated background.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm tan and copper tones of the male subject contrasting with the cool teal-grey background
Intricate white lace texture of the female subject's garment acting as a visual highlight
Tight, intimate framing with subjects overlapping to signify partnership
coreInvariants: Soft-focus studio lighting with warm skin tones
Typographic placement at the top center/upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a medium-long shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's tan fedora and the woman's white lace sleeve provide the primary light-value anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-center typography, move down to the subjects' faces, and follow the line of their intertwined hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room at the top and sides to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the white lace and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Wide-set Roman Serif and Ornate Copperplate Script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast strokes with sharp, triangular serifs
Secondary text uses extremely fine, hair-line flourishes and loops
Extreme horizontal tracking for the serif headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized and smaller than the surrounding caps
Script 'W' and 'A' feature oversized, circular swashes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, wide-tracked serif and a fluid, interlocking script.
graphicDevices: Typographic swashes that act as decorative dividers

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, wide-set serif look of the 70s.
Provides the necessary formal flourishes and hairline strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a couple in 1970s fashion (tan suit, fedora, white lace top, afro) against a muted teal-grey gradient background with soft vignette lighting. Leave the top 25% of the image as empty negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a wide-tracked, all-caps white serif font at the top. Directly beneath, add the secondary title in an ornate, white Spencerian script with interlocking flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the serif text tracking wide enough to span the width of the subjects?
Does the script text have delicate, hairline flourishes?
Is the background a desaturated teal-grey gradient?
Is the lighting warm and reminiscent of 1970s film photography?

adjustableVariables: Background color (can shift to warm brown or deep olive)
Subject attire (can vary within 70s bohemian/formal styles)
mustRedesign: Flat, even lighting (must be directional studio lighting)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography does not obscure faces
Verify the teal/tan color contrast balance
Confirm the script flourishes are legible but ornate
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Studio Portrait + Wide Serif Header + Ornate Script Subtitle + Earthy/Teal Palette
